card.name: Words just before a person or group
card.fires_on: Fires on a word right after a noun that names a leader, role or group, where the next word is likely a person or group, such as 's, of, tutor or guide. It appears in general web prose such as history and instructions.

modes.label: Possessive or 'of' after a role
modes.description: The marker 's or 'of' follows a leader, command or team noun and leads to a person or group.

modes.label: Role noun after a modifier
modes.description: A role word such as tutor or guide follows 'your' or 'tour' and is followed by a description of what that person does.
